item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.21
item.description: The timelines to overcut have their own wide list under the cards: bigger rows, wide enough for long timeline names, a box to find a timeline by name, Tick all / Untick all, and smooth scrolling.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.20
item.description: The timelines to overcut now have their own wide list under the cards: bigger rows, two or three columns, a box to find a timeline by name, Tick all / Untick all, and it scrolls smoothly (it no longer jumps while you scroll).

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.19
item.description: A little flourish when an overcut finishes (the wallet closes with a stitched tick), a stitched progress bar, and a tally: each result says how many tap clips were swapped and roughly how much time that saved, with a running total in the ⚙ panel.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.18
item.description: Send logs is easier: pick Gmail, Outlook, the Mail app or just the zip. Gmail and Outlook open in your browser with the email filled in, so nothing needs setting up on the Mac. Your choice is remembered for the Send logs buttons on error messages.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.17
item.description: The opening wallet shows OVER / CUTTER / HELPER on three lines, bigger.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.16
item.description: The opening wallet shows the name on two lines, a bit bigger.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.15
item.description: New: your last few cut bins and scene bins appear as one-click buttons on the cards. After an overcut or two, it says roughly how long this one will take, from how long they take on this Mac. Notifications and a Dock progress badge come with the 2.9.15 zip from the drive.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.14
item.description: New: a 'Check my setup' button (in the ⚙ panel) that checks ffmpeg, the bin reader and your saved folders. If a drive comes back as FAL_PRJ-1, the folder choosers still open in the right place and the check says why. After each update you'll see a short note like this one.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.13
item.description: Updates can now bring newer helper tools (Python, ffmpeg). Logs go to apps@drpob.com. Full zip needed once (2.9.13) for tool updates to take effect.

item.title: OverCutterHelper 2.9.12
item.description: When an overcut finishes, the result card reminds you to open the scene bins too if clips show offline or Match Frame can't find them.
